notes: E0 influence and concentration attack on the V2 deposited-capital family: pool and candidate contribution ledgers, the within-transformed predictor variance each candidate carries, and full-calendar refits dropping one candidate or one high-contribution pool at a time with the claim's own decision rule restated on each remainder. The five-candidate share denominator is held fixed when a candidate is dropped, so the diagnostic perturbs the sample and not the estimand. Leave-one-pool panels are recomputed from the released allocation rows and reconciled against the released capital column before any exclusion is taken
